label: Earth-Antiquity
policy: Period-wide toolkit; retain original late-Republic material and mark early/late applicability rather than implying universal simultaneity.

label: Earth-DarkAges
policy: Distinct culture selection. Overlap with Medieval is intentional. Does not imply a separate implemented Dark Ages item manifest.

label: Earth-Medieval
policy: High/late medieval emphasis; retain transitional material and the original combined pack as a compatibility path.

label: Earth-Renaissance
policy: One complete Europe/Near East pack, internally including required world-expansion content.

label: Earth-EarlyModern
policy: Reuse earlier shared entities; introduce genuinely distinct classes, naming changes and language stages only.
